v1.13.0 SHIPPED 2026-04-23 (tag 9e8f98c). Release recovery narrative: initial workflow hit "Error creating policy" from softprops/action-gh-release@v3, Windows artifact dropped + release stuck in draft. Manual recovery: Windows uploaded, draft published, Homebrew formula pushed by hand. #95 closed with v2.6.2 pin-back.

#96 SHIPPED 2026-04-28 via PR #98: re-pinned action-gh-release@v3.0.0 with continue-on-error attempt 1 + if:failure() retry. v1.13.0 transient could not be reproduced on a debug-tag rerun. See context.v113PolicyIncident.

v1.14.0 substantially complete (theme E — guardrails / data hygiene):
- #99 SHIPPED 2026-05-05 via PR #104 (merge d9126b4). projectResolution chokepoint. Auto-scope writes refuse on null project resolution. PROJECT_UNRESOLVED structured error. Behavior change beyond refusal — auto-mode project-then-global fallthrough on remove/alias-remove/confirm-remove also collapses (CHANGELOG breaking-changes entry).
- #102 SHIPPED 2026-05-05 via PRs #106/#107 (merge 001ac9e). MCP audit `project` field absolutized via setProjectRootOverride.
- #100 + #101 SHIPPED 2026-05-05 via PR #108 (merge d18923f). codex_context size-budget shedding (50KB default, files.* → arch.* → large context.*, never-shed list, pathological-overflow notice). codex_set write-amp warning on 3rd+ same-key write per session within 30 min. Telemetry/audit gained degraded/shedNamespaces/writeAmpWarning/writeAmpCount. AsyncLocalStorage for guardrail-signal propagation. UTF-8-accurate Buffer.byteLength sizing.
- #103 IN PR #109. Tier semantics docs in schema-guide.md. Last open issue in v1.14.0.

Test count: 1325 → 1394 (+69 across the v1.14 cycle).

#84 (entry health, milestone candidate) deferred to v1.15. Pairs with search (theme B, project.v115Hints).

DOGFOODING PART THREE: expected alongside v1.14.0 tag. Narrative — "the loop closed and showed us a hole" + "we codified the soak policy from the same data" + "guardrails grew from the FA-iOS dataset mine".

NEXT: after #109 merges, run docs/release-checklist.md (bump package.json, CHANGELOG header transform, release alias).
